data.why: The repo bundles no ABF sample recordings; the app expects an uploaded whole-cell current-clamp ABF with multiple current-step sweeps for spike detection and feature extraction.

goals: Upload a whole-cell current-clamp ABF recording and detect action potentials across current-step sweeps
Adjust voltage and derivative detection thresholds to reliably capture spikes while excluding noise
Extract electrophysiological features (resting voltage, input resistance, membrane time constant, latency to first spike) per sweep
Build an F-I curve to characterize firing rate as a function of injected current
Compare spike counts and features across multiple sweeps or files
Export results as CSV, Excel, or PDF summary plots for reporting

review.summary: The tree captures Spike Doctor's purpose and the README's upload → parameters → features → review → export flow at a sensible depth, and the screens I sampled match their nodes. Before filing, it needs a few targeted fixes: limit the derivative-threshold claim to what was observed, add a passive-properties task and the summary-panel feature, fix the weak download citations, and flag the debug-legend count discrepancy.
